correctness.rationale: The exact triangular-hat Jensen gap equals (|a-b|/4-|y+(a+b)/2|/2)_+, whose weighted conditional rth integral has support width |a-b| and unweighted integral |a-b|^{r+1}/(4^r(r+1)). The block-difference CLT, moment uniform integrability, local continuity of f and negligible far-support contribution yield the stated unrestricted constants. Independence yields (1-p_n)^M pilot limits; fourth/second moment orders yield centered kurtosis. In the Gaussian case orthogonal sum/difference normals and polar integration give the exact half-normal-difference distribution and angular moment formulas. Both r=0 for support and 5+delta moment boundary are explicitly handled. Numerical independent Gaussian quadratures corroborate but do not prove asymptotics.

The Gaussian subfamily has an explicit all-order finite-n distribution.
